name: EAPcontroller
description: TP-LINK's free EAP Controller Software allows users to easily manage hundreds of TPLINK EAPs in multiple sites with the controller in a single location. Directions: /config : The host path needs to have a direct path, example "/mnt/cache" or /mnt/disk1 or mongodb cant start(cant handle Unraid "shfs") Custom certificate Stop the container and put the cert in "/config/cert" it needs to be named "mydomain.p12" and have the password "tplink".
